One parallel six-verifier batch returned native mutex lock failed: Invalid argument in single-population and joined-population. No failing query phase/backtrace was captured. Single reruns, a two-verifier parallel rerun, traced six-process batch and final six-process batch passed. Actual common root cause remains unknown; no claim that it is fixed.

Existing single-population verifier had fail-fast same-connection concurrent query cleanup that could disconnect before all tasks settled. Changed to one outstanding query per connection, wait-all-settled creation/execution, all connection cleanup and first-error retention. This is a proven harness defect, not proof of the common mutex root cause.
